title: Notes on Reversed Products of Two Elements in Rings
summary: This paper investigates reversed product properties of two elements in rings. Motivated by Cline's formula, we characterize reversible and $\ast$-reversible rings in terms of group invertible elements, EP elements, and the transfer behaviour of generalized inverses for reversed products. We prove that a unital ring $R$ is reversible if and only if $ab\in R^{\sharp}$ yields $ba\in R^{\sharp}$. For an involutive ring $R$, $R$ is $\ast$-reversible precisely whenever $ab\in R^{\mathrm{EP}}$ implies $b^{\ast}a\in R^{\mathrm{EP}}$.
